headline: Bangladesh Textile Factory Strike Paralyzes 529 Plants
summary: A labor strike in Bangladesh has halted operations across 529 garment factories, threatening international apparel supply chains and exports.
why: Bangladesh is one of the world's largest exporters of ready-made garments, serving major global fashion brands and retailers.

impacts.name: Apparel and Textile
impacts.why: Factory shutdowns directly disrupt apparel manufacturing and export volumes.
